req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema (TaskBase) enforces title as required (Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)). Tests cover: (1) positive — valid payload with title present returns 201; (2) negative — payload with title completely absent returns 422; (3) boundary — payload with title as empty string (min_length=1 violated) returns 422; (4) boundary — payload with title as single character (min_length=1 satisfied) returns 201; (5) negative — payload with null title returns 422. These collectively catch mutations on the status code constant (422 vs 200/201/400), the min_length constraint (1 vs 0), and the required-field enforcement logic.

expected: Response body contains the submitted title
Response body contains id, completed=false, created_at
trace: R-TASK-002 — positive equivalence partition: title present and valid
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert "created_at" in body

        "title": "Fix login bug",

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_missing_title_status_code_is_not_400_or_200():
    payload = {"completed": True}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
